Bollywood Stars Aid Actor Sudhir Dalvi with Hospital Bills

Actors Ranbir Kapoor, Akshay Kumar, and Kartik Aaryan have contributed financially to help actor Sudhir Dalvi, known for his role as Sai Baba in the 1977 film 'Shirdi Ke Sai Baba', with his hospital expenses. Dalvi was admitted to the ICU, and his hospital bill had reportedly reached ₹19 lakh. The financial assistance from the Bollywood actors aimed to cover these medical costs.
